001package com.streamConverter.factory;
002
003import java.lang.reflect.Constructor;
004import java.util.Map;
005import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
006import org.slf4j.Logger;
007import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
008
009/**
010 * Abstract Factory base class providing common factory functionality.
011 *
012 * <p>This class provides shared infrastructure for all factory implementations, including caching,
013 * reflection-based instance creation, and logging integration.
014 *
015 * <p>Key features:
016 *
017 * <ul>
018 *   <li>Thread-safe instance caching with ConcurrentHashMap
019 *   <li>Reflection-based instance creation with type compatibility checking
020 *   <li>Unified logging and error handling
021 *   <li>Configuration management for factory settings
022 * </ul>
023 *
024 * @param <T> the type of instances created by this factory
025 * @since 1.0
026 */
027public abstract class AbstractFactory<T> {
028  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AbstractFactory.class);
029
030  /** Thread-safe cache for created instances */
031  protected final Map<String, T> instanceCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
032
033  /** Factory configuration settings */
034  protected final FactoryConfiguration config;
035
036  /** Constructs an AbstractFactory with default configuration. */
037  protected AbstractFactory() {
038    this.config = FactoryConfiguration.defaultConfig();
039    log.debug("Initialized {} with default configuration", getClass().getSimpleName());
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Constructs an AbstractFactory with specified configuration.
044   *
045   * @param config the factory configuration
046   */
047  protected AbstractFactory(FactoryConfiguration config) {
048    this.config = config != null ? config : FactoryConfiguration.defaultConfig();
049    log.debug("Initialized {} with custom configuration", getClass().getSimpleName());
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Creates an instance using reflection with intelligent constructor matching.
054   *
055   * @param <U> the specific type of instance to create
056   * @param clazz the class to instantiate
057   * @param args constructor arguments
058   * @return created instance
059   * @throws FactoryException if instance creation fails
060   */
061  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
062  protected <U extends T> U createInstance(Class<U> clazz, Object... args) throws FactoryException {
063    try {
064      // Try default constructor first
065      if (args.length == 0) {
066        Constructor<U> constructor = clazz.getDeclaredConstructor();
067        constructor.setAccessible(true);
068        return constructor.newInstance();
069      }
070
071      // Find best matching constructor
072      Constructor<U> bestMatch = findBestMatchingConstructor(clazz, args);
073      bestMatch.setAccessible(true);
074      return bestMatch.newInstance(args);
075
076    } catch (Exception e) {
077      String message =
078          String.format(
079              "Failed to create instance of %s with %d arguments",
080              clazz.getSimpleName(), args.length);
081      log.error(message, e);
082      throw new FactoryException(message, e);
083    }
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * Finds the best matching constructor for the given arguments.
088   *
089   * @param <U> the type to construct
090   * @param clazz the class
091   * @param args constructor arguments
092   * @return best matching constructor
093   * @throws NoSuchMethodException if no compatible constructor found
094   */
095  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
096  private <U extends T> Constructor<U> findBestMatchingConstructor(Class<U> clazz, Object[] args)
097      throws NoSuchMethodException {
098    Constructor<?>[] constructors = clazz.getDeclaredConstructors();
099
100    // First pass: exact match
101    for (Constructor<?> constructor : constructors) {
102      if (isExactMatch(constructor, args)) {
103        return (Constructor<U>) constructor;
104      }
105    }
106
107    // Second pass: compatible match
108    for (Constructor<?> constructor : constructors) {
109      if (isCompatibleMatch(constructor, args)) {
110        return (Constructor<U>) constructor;
111      }
112    }
113
114    throw new NoSuchMethodException(
115        String.format(
116            "No compatible constructor found for %s with argument types: %s",
117            clazz.getSimpleName(), getArgumentTypes(args)));
118  }
119
120  /** Checks if constructor parameters exactly match argument types. */
121  private boolean isExactMatch(Constructor<?> constructor, Object[] args) {
122    Class<?>[] paramTypes = constructor.getParameterTypes();
123    if (paramTypes.length != args.length) {
124      return false;
125    }
126
127    for (int i = 0; i < paramTypes.length; i++) {
128      if (!paramTypes[i].equals(args[i].getClass())) {
129        return false;
130      }
131    }
132    return true;
133  }
134
135  /** Checks if constructor parameters are compatible with argument types. */
136  private boolean isCompatibleMatch(Constructor<?> constructor, Object[] args) {
137    Class<?>[] paramTypes = constructor.getParameterTypes();
138    if (paramTypes.length != args.length) {
139      return false;
140    }
141
142    for (int i = 0; i < paramTypes.length; i++) {
143      if (!isTypeCompatible(paramTypes[i], args[i].getClass())) {
144        return false;
145      }
146    }
147    return true;
148  }
149
150  /** Checks type compatibility including primitives and inheritance. */
151  private boolean isTypeCompatible(Class<?> paramType, Class<?> argType) {
152    if (paramType.equals(argType)) {
153      return true;
154    }
155
156    // Primitive and wrapper type compatibility
157    if (isPrimitiveWrapperMatch(paramType, argType)) {
158      return true;
159    }
160
161    // Inheritance compatibility
162    return paramType.isAssignableFrom(argType);
163  }
164
165  /** Map of primitive types to their corresponding wrapper classes. */
166  private static final java.util.Map<Class<?>, Class<?>> PRIMITIVE_WRAPPER_MAP =
167      java.util.Map.of(
168          int.class, Integer.class,
169          long.class, Long.class,
170          boolean.class, Boolean.class,
171          double.class, Double.class,
172          float.class, Float.class,
173          char.class, Character.class,
174          byte.class, Byte.class,
175          short.class, Short.class);
176
177  /** Checks if parameter and argument are primitive/wrapper type pair. */
178  private boolean isPrimitiveWrapperMatch(Class<?> paramType, Class<?> argType) {
179    return PRIMITIVE_WRAPPER_MAP.get(paramType) == argType;
180  }
181
182  /** Gets string representation of argument types for error messages. */
183  private String getArgumentTypes(Object[] args) {
184    if (args.length == 0) {
185      return "[]";
186    }
187
188    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("[");
189    for (int i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
190      if (i > 0) sb.append(", ");
191      sb.append(args[i].getClass().getSimpleName());
192    }
193    sb.append("]");
194    return sb.toString();
195  }
196
197  /**
198   * Creates a cache key for the given parameters.
199   *
200   * @param keyComponents components to create key from
201   * @return cache key string
202   */
203  protected String createCacheKey(Object... keyComponents) {
204    if (keyComponents.length == 0) {
205      return "default";
206    }
207
208    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
209    for (int i = 0; i < keyComponents.length; i++) {
210      if (i > 0) sb.append(":");
211      sb.append(keyComponents[i] != null ? keyComponents[i].toString() : "null");
212    }
213    return sb.toString();
214  }
215
216  /**
217   * Gets cached instance or null if not found.
218   *
219   * @param key cache key
220   * @return cached instance or null
221   */
222  protected T getCachedInstance(String key) {
223    return instanceCache.get(key);
224  }
225
226  /**
227   * Caches an instance with the given key.
228   *
229   * @param key cache key
230   * @param instance instance to cache
231   */
232  protected void cacheInstance(String key, T instance) {
233    if (config.isCachingEnabled()) {
234      instanceCache.put(key, instance);
235      log.debug("Cached instance: {} -> {}", key, instance.getClass().getSimpleName());
236    }
237  }
238
239  /** Clears all cached instances. */
240  public void clearCache() {
241    int cacheSize = instanceCache.size();
242    instanceCache.clear();
243    log.info("Cleared factory cache: {} instances removed", cacheSize);
244  }
245
246  /**
247   * Gets current cache size.
248   *
249   * @return number of cached instances
250   */
251  public int getCacheSize() {
252    return instanceCache.size();
253  }
254
255  /**
256   * Gets factory configuration.
257   *
258   * @return current configuration
259   */
260  public FactoryConfiguration getConfiguration() {
261    return config;
262  }
263}
